title: Ticking Delete on Work orders also ticks Create & Edit and View
custom_preconds: 1. In the Work orders card, View, Create & Edit and Delete are all unticked.
custom_steps:
1. Tick the Delete box on Work orders.
  2. Look at View, Create & Edit and Delete.
custom_expected:
View ticks automatically.

Create & Edit ticks automatically.

Delete is ticked.
evidence: UI: ticking Work orders Delete auto-ticks Create & Edit and View (all ON).
